name: Absolute Cinema
description: Your face in the centre of the Absolute Cinema poster.
origin: Martin Scorsese with both hands raised, captioned “Absolute Cinema”. Used when something is a masterpiece.
whatHappens: Your video becomes the poster: black-and-white, a dramatic vignette and film grain, a slow push-in, and ABSOLUTE CINEMA in big white letters. It stays while you hold the pose.
how: Raise both open hands beside your head, palms to the camera, fingers spread. Hold for half a second.
tips: Hands beside your head, not in front of your face.
Spread your fingers like in the poster.
